info.title: L'invincibile Dendoh (ITA)
info.synopsis: Giappone ai giorni nostri. Un gigantesco robot, precipita sulla terra come un meteorite, insieme ad una ragazza bionda con il viso coperto da una strana maschera. Dopo diciasette anni da questo avvenimento, gli alieni dell'impero meccanico dei Gulfer attaccano la terra; sono delle bestie elettroniche il cui scopo è quello di distruggere la popolazione terrestre. La difesa militare del nostro pianeta è organizzata dalla GEAR, ma tutti i suoi mezzi appaiono inadeguati rispetto alla sofisticata tecnologia aliena. Le uniche speranze per contrastare gli invasori sono riposte su Dendoh, il mega robot precipitato sulla terra diversi anni prima!

info.title: Il castello errante di Howl
info.synopsis: Sophie è una ragazza che lavora in un negozio che confeziona enormi e variopinti cappelli. Un giorno, viene tratta in salvo da uno strano personaggio, inseguito da delle strane figure che, vedendoli assieme, si mettono ad inseguire entrambi. Scampato il pericolo, Sophie ritorna nel negozio, ma viene raggiunta da una donna. Questa donna è nientedimeno che la Strega delle Ande, che le lancia una maledizione... Sophie è costretta a mettersi in viaggio per cercare di rompere l'incantesimo e trovare il mago che ha dato inizio a tutti i suoi guai.

La Thousand Sunny, grazie al nuovo rivestimento, ora è in grado di navigare sott'acqua e raggiunge la famosa isola degli Uomini Pesce. Dopo varie peripezie nel palazzo reale, la ciurma inconterà e sfiderà il temibile Hody Jones, un ammiratore di Arlong, che sta tentando di impadronirsi dell'isola e che nutre un feroce rancore verso gli umani, colpevoli, a suo dire, di aver vessato e ridotto in schiavitù i suoi simili.

info.title: Mobile Suit Gundam 00
info.synopsis: Dopo l'esaurimento dei combustibili fossili, l'umanità è stata costretta a ripiegare sull'energia solare, costruendo un sistema di anelli orbitanti intorno al pianeta in grado di accumulare e trasferire l'energia. Tali anelli sono stati divisi tra le tre potenze politiche ed economiche in cui si è diviso il pianeta: l’AEU (la nuova Unione Europea), l’Union (America) e l’Alleanza (Asia). Questi tre blocchi si trovano in uno stato di costante guerra fredda che, pur non palesandosi in aperte ostilità, porta a un continuo sviluppo di armi e allo sfoggio della rispettiva potenza e un continuo proliferare dei conflitti, per ragioni di razza, religione o per l’estromissione dall'utilizzo dell'energia solare. In questo quadro appaiono i Gundam Meister il cui compito dovrebbe essere quello di estirpare la guerra tramite l’intervento armato realizzato per mezzo dei Gundam, mobile suit avanzatissimi che non hanno rivali.

episodes.title: Celestial Being
episodes.synopsis: Celestial Being, a private army dedicated to eradicating war, begins demonstrating the powers of their new "MS-GUNDAM" suits by interrupting the public demonstration of AEU's latest Mobile Suit, the AEU Enact and by protecting the Human Reform League's Space Elevator, "Tenchu" from being attacked by terrorists when their mobile suits had attempted to launch rockets on the "Tenchu", earning a news appearance from various TV news channels where Celestial Being's goals were publicly stated by Aeoria Schenberg.

episodes.title: Gundam Meisters
episodes.synopsis: The world bodies discusses the possible origins and impact of Celestial Being. The Gundams made their first combat appearance in Ceylon, formerly called Sri Lanka where Lockon leads the Gundams in taking on the Human Reform League and rebel Sri Lankan forces. Meanwhile, JNN reporter Kinue Crossroad discovers something about Aeoria Schenberg's origins. The episode ends with Graham Aker ambushing Setsuna to sate his curiosity about the Gundams.

episodes.title: The Changing World
episodes.synopsis: Setsuna dispatches Graham with ease, the latter being caught off guard by the advanced technology of the Gundams. Tieria returns to space with Gundam Virtue. The Union Army creates the Anti-Gundam Investigative Squad with Graham and Billy transferred from the MSWAD as official members. Meanwhile, Celestial Being launches surprise attacks in South Africa, the South American continent over Taribian airspace, formerly in Venezuela and Guyana, and in Ceylon. Setsuna later faces off against Colonel Smirnov while conducting an attack against Human Reform League mobile suits. Later on, a JNN broadcast revealed that various militant factions in North Ireland signed a peace treaty, ending years of fighting between themselves, the British Army and the PSNI.

episodes.title: International Negotiation
episodes.synopsis: Colonel Sergei returns to the Reform League to head a new squad designated for capturing one of the Gundams, with Soma Peries as his designated subordinate. Encouraged by Celestial Being's anti-conflict actions, the South American nation of Taribia declares its withdrawal from the Union and declares it independence over the control of energy resources, prompting a Union military response, forcing Celestial Being to intervene. In Azadistan (In the territory of Iran), Shirin Bakhtiar explains to First Princess Marina Ismail that the conflict is not as simple as it may first seem. Meanwhile, the Anti-Gundam Investigative Squad, in Flag Customs, engage Exia in Taribian airspace. Later on, pro-Taribian separatist politicians led by its prime minister are forced to drop their bid for independence after their forces were defeated by the Gundam Meisters.

episodes.title: Escape Limit Zone
episodes.synopsis: Colonel Sergei conducts tests on a new Mobile Suit built especially for Soma Peries, a bioengineered human. Allelujah Haptism and Soma Peries experience a strange connection brought on by their proximity to each other. This causes Soma Peries to go into a fit of rage who begins to fire shots randomly at the space elevator severing a section containing civilians. Meanwhile on board the elevator Allelujah Haptism experiences another side of himself but regains his composure and runs off. Colonel Sergei attempts to help the civilians before they drift past the Breakaway Limit Zone and into the Earth's atmosphere but his mobile suit is ill-equipped. Allelujah Haptism, piloting the Gundam Kyrios, arrives to aid the Colonel.They save the civilians but at the cost of revealing Dynames' GN Sniper Rifle Extreme Long Range Custom.

episodes.title: Seven Swords
episodes.synopsis: The Republic of Moralia, located in the southeast of France (what today is the Principality of Monaco) and a member of the AEU, has placed in armed forces in joint exercise with French-led AEU forces, including Patrick Colasour. Marina heads to France to request humanitarian assistance, despite the incomplete status of the AEU's Orbital Elevator. Meanwhile, Celestial Being Gundam Meisters were led by Sumeragi Noriega and her crew (except Lichtendahl Caeli and Lasse Aion) alongside Wang Liu Mei in disrupting the exercises, taking on both Moralian and AEU mobile suits. Later on, Setsuna is surprised when he takes on Ali Al-Saachez, a figure from his past, in his custom-made AEU Enact prototype.

episodes.title: Unrewarded Souls
episodes.synopsis: The Gundam Meisters were able to defeat the Moralian Army, despite an earlier attempt by Setsuna to confirm if Ali was in the AEU Enact prototype that he fought with. Their actions had formed the Moralian Armed Forces to surrender to the Meisters after the previous State of emergency was declared. While Setsuna was being reprimanded by Lockon and Tieria for placing all of Celestial Being in danger for the potential of having their real identities exposed, an unknown terrorist group had conducted simultaneous bombings in various nations as a warning message to take on Celestial Being with more indiscriminate bombings unless the group disbands.

episodes.title: Indiscriminate Retaliation
episodes.synopsis: The Gundam Meisters are being sent off to investigate the terrorists responsible for the indiscriminate bombings in the Union, HRL and AEU. In Scotland, Setsuna attempts to capture one of the bombers, but was nearly apprehended by a Scottish Authorised Firearms Officer after firing his pistol if not for Marina's intervention.

episodes.title: The Honor of a Great Power
episodes.synopsis: It has been four months since Celestial Being's first intervention and the Gundam Meisters have been involved in over sixty intervention operations. As the world begins to change around them, the crew aboard the Ptolemy and the Gundam Meisters have some time to themselves.

episodes.title: Operation Gundam Capture
episodes.synopsis: The HRL's operation against the Celestial Being continues. Allelujah again becomes disorientated by his proximity to Soma Peries resulting in the capture of Kyrios. Tieria arrives to find the captured Kyrios within a transport vessel. As he attempts to destroy the vessel before it escapes the Virtue is overwhelmed. Meanwhile, Allelujah's other half Hallelujah awakens and destroys the transport ship he is inside. He then goes off to face Soma Peries and Sergei Smirnov, but they escape. The battle finally ends though it is a Pyrrhic victory for both sides, with Tieria revealing one of the Celestial Beings greatest secret GN-004 Nadleeh and the HRL losing many mobile suits in return. With the near capture of Kyrios and Ptolemaios' close escape, Celestial Being is shaken to the core with the majority of its members saddened by the experience.

episodes.title: Allelujah
episodes.synopsis: Allelujah Haptism decides to face his past and proposes a mission to destroy the facility where he was 'created'. Sumeragi accepts his proposal and launches Exia and Dynames to attack South Africa as a diversion while Kyrios and Virtue assault the HRL colony where the illegal experiments on children have been conducted. Flashbacks of Allelujah's turbulent past is shown as he grapples with the decision to open fire on the experimental lab. Celestial Being then leaks information on the experiments to the media, turning it into an international incident and a public relations disaster for the HRL. Sergei becomes aware of the experiments and detains one of the scientists responsible and who also tried to cover it up. Kinue also continues her investigation into Aeolia Schenberg, delving deeper into the mysteries surrounding Celestial Being's founder.

episodes.title: To the Limits of Holy Teachings
episodes.synopsis: An Imam named Massad Rachmadi was kidnapped by an unknown armed group, which led to riots by the Azadistani populations against the military called in to guard the city. Celestial Being and the Union Army began to intervene when radical factions in the Azadistani military began to attack loyalist forces guarding the Solar Antenna to link up with the Orbital Elevator. As Celestial Being and Graham's forces, grudgingly, face off against rebel Azadistani mobile suits, Setsuna is forced to re-live the events of his traumatic past after encountering Azadistani military mobile suits attacking armed children.

episodes.title: Return of the Saint
episodes.synopsis: With the whereabouts of Massad Rachmadi unknown, Azadistan falls into a state of civil unrest with constant terror attacks. Reviewing the previous battle, Lockon reveals the possibility that there may be a third force aside from the Union-Azadistan forces and Celestial Being. After Setsuna and the duo of Graham and Billy investigate the possible site of where missiles had been launched by Ali, Setsuna deduces that location of where terrorist forces, led by Ali himself, are located. Setsuna and Lockon, with the assistance of Hong Long, attack the terrorist hideout. Setsuna manages to hold his own against Ali, who manages to escape from the battle, while Lockon and Hong Long utilizes the distraction to rescue Rachmadi. Deciding to display a show of bravado, Celestial Being authorizes Setsuna to deliver Rachmadi to the Azadistan royal palace with Exia unarmed. Despite pressure from present Union and Azadistan forces, the hostage release is successful. Marina asks the pilot of Exia if he is truly Setsuna, to which Setsuna vaguely encourages Marina to take up the fight for peace in Azadistan.

episodes.title: Dawn of Determination
episodes.synopsis: With Ptolemaios undergoing maintenance the members of the Celestial Being take a short day off on Earth. Meanwhile the Union, AEU, and the HRL hold a secret meeting to discuss plans for "Project G", a joint project of the three groups to try to capture or destroy the Gundams. From the public's point of view it is stated as a joint military exercise by the three groups. Information later comes in that the three armies will converge at a point in the Taklamakan Desert with a high risk of spreading nuclear radiation around the world if careful measures aren't taken. Celestial Being decide to intervene, fully knowing the true objective of the enemy's plans and that they are extremely outnumbered and that they may not come out unscathed. Meanwhile, Setsuna takes a short detour to Azadistan to ask and listen to Marina's opinion of why the world is so distorted.

episodes.title: Broken Wings
episodes.synopsis: As planned, Celestial Being begins their armed intervention in the Taklamakan Desert against a combined force of nearly a thousand mobile suits from the Union, AEU, and HRL. Immediately upon involving themselves, the four Gundam Meisters are attacked and face a ruthless bombardment from the allied forces for nearly fifteen straight hours. Exhausted and pushed to the limits of their abilities, the Meisters then find themselves pitted against ace pilots sent from the allied forces, with the intent of capturing them. Outnumbered and overwhelmed, the Gundams are one by one disabled and deactivated, until only Setsuna remains. Then, just as he's about to be finished off, a mysterious mobile suit, emitting red wing-like GN particles, appears and drives the enemy away.

episodes.title: Trinity
episodes.synopsis: Three new mobile suits, piloted by a trio of siblings, appear on the battlefield and reveal themselves as Gundam Throne Eins, Zwei, and Drei. Caught off-guard by the new Gundams' sudden arrival, the Union, AEU, and HRL forces are decimated and forced to retreat. In order to secure a route of escape, Gundam Throne Drei covers the entire region in GN particles, causing havoc with enemy communications and preventing a counterattack. After escaping from the Taklamakan Desert, the rescued Gundam Meisters are anxious about the new units and disturbed about not knowing of their existence. While world leaders despair at the appearance of the new Gundams, Alejandro Corner attends an anonymous conference with the other Celestial Being "observers" to review Celestial Being's activities and to discuss the acknowledgement of the Gundam Thrones. Aboard their spaceship, the Trinity siblings fly to meet the Ptolemaios to greet the Gundam Meisters.

episodes.title: Assault of the Thrones
episodes.synopsis: The Gundam Throne pilots--Johann, Michael, and Nena Trinity--meet with the crew of the Ptolemaios, and declare themselves as allies working independently of the current Meisters. However, they reveal little information about themselves and their Gundams, leaving the two groups first meeting with strained results. However, Sumeragi later reveals that she had Ian Vasty secretly obtain information about the Gundam Thrones.

episodes.title: The Aim of Evil Intents
episodes.synopsis: The Gundam Thrones continue to attack military installations around the globe, their aggressive tactics forcing the Celestial Being observers and the Gundam Meisters aside and out of the forefront of battle. The crew of the Ptolemaios investigate the Thrones and their origins, including the possibility that Veda was hacked by an outsider to acquire the technology behind the GN Drive. On the civilian forefront, Kinue Crossroad obtains a new lead after learning that one of the Throne pilots mentioned something called 'Ragna'.

episodes.title: Bonds
episodes.synopsis: As Setsuna attacks the three Gundam Thrones, he is surprisingly assisted by Tieria and Lockon. Tieria reveals Gundam Nadleeh's Trial System can disable any Mobile Suit linked with Veda. However, the Thrones manage to escape after informing Lockon that Setsuna was once a child soldier of the terrorist organization that was responsible for the death of Lockon's family. Lockon confronts Setsuna, but Setsuna's explanation of his past, as well as his conviction to end warfare as a Gundam Meister, defuses the situation. Meanwhile, Louise asks Saji to return to Japan to fulfill his dream as an aerospace engineer and to move on remembering the memories as dreams, and Kinue discovers that "Ragna" refers to the president of the corporation constructing linear elevators for the Orbital Elevators. Meanwhile, as Alejandro and Livonze continue their mysterious agenda, the three superpowers, about to surrender before the Gundams, are contacted by a member of Celestial Being to reveal a facility in Antarctica housing 30 GN Drives.

episodes.title: Blade of Reformation
episodes.synopsis: The three superpowers unite to eliminate Celestial Being and form a combined military force under the UN's command. Each of the powers receives 10 of the 30 GN-Xs, the GN-Drive powered mobile suits they found in Antarctica. However, Graham refuses to pilot one, hoping to fulfill Howard's wish of defeating the Gundams using a Flag. Meanwhile, Kinue Crossroad encounters Ali Al Sarshes, who has just met with Ragna Harvey.

episodes.title: Path of Destruction
episodes.synopsis: Saji mourns the loss of his sister. The Trinity siblings are betrayed and launch a brief counterattack after their compound's location is revealed, destroying one of the 10 GN-X units from Choubu's assault force. The UN Army continues its assault on Celestial Being, attacking the Ptolemaios in space. Raguna Harvey is killed after Corner learns that it was he that created and sold the GN-X units. The Meisters' units are out-numbered, and they struggle to defend themselves against the GN-Xs firepower. During the battle, Alejandro Corner accesses Veda and deactivates the GN drive of the Meisters' units, leaving them defenseless. However, Sumaragi activates a backup system and every unit except Virtue is able to reactivate. Seeing Tieria's crippled state, Patrick Colasaur goes for the killing blow. Lockon is able to intercept the attack, but is severely injured. The battle ends with the UN Army retreating after losing two of their GN-X units, and the timely arrival of the GN Arms.

episodes.title: Trans-Am
episodes.synopsis: As Lockon recovers from his injuries, the UN Army announces its plan to destroy the Gundams, "Operation Fallen Angel". The HRL's Choubu Squadron continues to harass the exhausted Trinity siblings. Observing on Ptolemaios, the Meisters wonder if they must be destroyed to finally end war. Setsuna rejects this notion, stating that the actions of both the Thrones and the U.N.

episodes.title: Stop the World
episodes.synopsis: Nena Trinity mourns the death of her brothers. Meanwhile on the moon Alejandro Coroner becomes incresingly agitated by Aeolia Schenberg's foresight. The crew of the Ptolemaios finish repairs to Dynames and pick up another GN Arms from its asteroid base within the Laragne 1 resource asteroid belt. The crew discuss the Trans-Am system, commenting how it provides a boost to performance, but only lasts a short time before the GN Drive must replenish the spent energy. Setsuna and Lasse make their way back to Ptolemaios and detect UN carrier ships heading to the Meisters' location. Warned of the attack, Allelujah and Tieria deploy in their Gundams, but Lockon is prevented from leaving. The battle soon commences between the Gundams and GN-X along with Ali Al Sarchez in the Gundam Throne Zwei. Allelujah and Tieria activate their Trans-Am systems and quickly destroy numerous GN-X. However, they become overwhelmed when their Trans-Am systems power down. Relief appears in the form of Dynames docked with its GN Arms system. Lockon uses the weapons platform to destroy more GN-X and two of the carrier ships before it is destroyed by Ali. Lockon chases after Ali determined to avenge his dead family. Zwei and Dynames engage in a vicious battle and Ali manages to cripple Lockon's Gundam. While Lockon makes Haro pilot the suit back to Ptolemaios, he exits the Gundam with his targeting rifle. Using an intact GN Cannon from his destroyed GN Arms, Lockon succeeds in destroying Zwei, but a shot from Zwei also damages the Cannon. As Lockon floats nearby he thinks about the world, its state and how he dilikes the current world. Holding his hand out to the world he questions those living on the Earth, if they like the current world because he doesn't. The GN Cannon explodes killing Lockon. Celestial Being suffer their first devestating loss leaving Setsuna to scream into the depths of space.

episodes.title: Endless Poem
episodes.synopsis: Setsuna contemplates his memories of Lockon, who vouched for him when he first became a Meister. Tieria blames Setsuna for Lockon's death, but Sumeragi reminds him that their true enemies are still nearby. Meanwhile, having lost over half their GN-X and the Throne Zwei, Sergei suggests the UN force withdraw. However, UN headquarters reveals that reinforcements are coming and orders a second attack. Back on Ptolemaios, the Gundams undergo repairs and upgrades. Tieria suggesting they destroy all the pseudo-GN Drives so that they can resume their original plan. The rest of the crew contemplate their pasts, but an alarm signals that the UN forces have arrived. Alejandro Corner joins the UN forces in a large, golden Mobile Armor and fires a massive particle cannon at the Ptolemaios, which barely evades the blast. With Kyrios and Nadleeh protecting the ship, Setsuna and Lasse attack Alejandro but can't penetrate his GN Shield. Alejandro continues to fire on Ptolemaios causing massive damage. Tieria activates his Trans-Am system and destroys several GN-X, including Patrick Colasour's GN-X, but suffers extensive damage. A GN-X manages to approach Ptolemaios and fires directly into the bridge resulting in the death of Christina and Lichtendahl. Sumeragi, Ian and Feldt manage to escape in one of Ptolemios' containers. Lasse rams Exia's container into Alejandro's shield and breaks through. Exia and the GN Arms escape the destroyed container and charge back at Alejandro.

episodes.title: Setsuna
episodes.synopsis:
Setsuna continues to struggle against Alejandro's weapons and shield. Exia docks with the GN Arms and evens the odds with the Alvatore. Setsuna succeeds in destroying Alejandro's shield but the GN Arms is destroyed in the process. Meanwhile, Sergei and Soma search for Kyrios. Allelujah wishes to know the meaning of their fight and unites with Hallelujah to face the two GN-Xs. Allelujah destroys Soma's GN-X and cripples Sergei but does not finish them off when he recognizes Soma as someone from his past. With his mobile armor damaged, Alejandro emerges in a golden mobile suit. Setsuna uses Exia's 'trump card' (his physical GN Blade) to bypass Alejandro's GN Shield and defeat him. Alejandro gets a message from Livonze revealing that Alejandro was a pawn and that Livonze is the true mastermind, right before Alvatore explodes. Graham then appears in his GN Drive-equipped Flag and engages Setsuna. Setsuna and Graham finally reveal themselves to each other and destroy each other's mobile suits. On Earth, Marina reads a letter from Setsuna questioning the current state of the world and how he hoped she'd help him learn the answers. Setsuna lies unconscious as Exia floats in space.

Four years later (A.D. 2312), Saji writes a letter to Louise from space and says he is still waiting for her. He sees a GN particle trail in the distance and recognizes it as a Gundam. The UN has become the Earth Sphere Federation and all countries have disarmed and formed the ESF peacekeeping force. On Celestial Being's asteroid base, Ian talks with Wang Liu Mei about deploying their new mobile suits. Liu Mei asks to see the O Gundam, the first generation unit, and then comments that the OO Gundam will change the world.

info.title: Long Riders!
info.synopsis: La storia segue le vicende di Ami Kurata, una studentessa universitaria al suo primo anno e priva di qualità particolari. Un giorno le capita di notare che qualcuno che sta pedalando una bicicletta pieghevole, di cui si innamora all'istante e decide di iniziare a risparmiare per potersene permettere una. La ragazza finisce per entrare nel mondo del ciclismo e delle corse su strada e forma un team di cicliste chiamato "Fortuna" con altre quattro colleghe universitarie. Il loro obbiettivo è riuscire a correre in un "brevet" o una gara di lunga distanza chiamata "Fresh".

episodes.title: A Small Miracle
episodes.synopsis: Upon entering college with her friend Aoi Niigaki, Ami Kurata takes an interest in cycling after seeing someone ride a folding bicycle. After visiting a few cycle shops and spotting several expensive bicycles, Ami eventually manages to find one within her price range, buying it straight away.

episodes.title: Seaside Cycling
episodes.synopsis: Over the weekend, Hinako and Yayoi invite Ami and Aoi to Miura for a ride along the coastline.

episodes.title: A New World
episodes.synopsis: The girls set off for Yabitsu Pass, which is more challenging than the hills Ami has previously faced.

episodes.title: The Secret Part-Time Job
episodes.synopsis: Taking an interest in owning a road bike, Ami spots one on sale and puts down a deposit for it, only to discover that the pedals and other accessories are sold separately.

episodes.title: A Different World
episodes.synopsis: Ami finally picks up her road bike, instantly coming to enjoy the feel of riding it.

episodes.title: Fortuna
episodes.synopsis: Wanting to prove that she has gotten better at cycling, Ami requests to once again try riding Yabitsu Pass with the others.

episodes.title: The Bonds of the Team
episodes.synopsis: As Ami gives her bikes a wash, Aoi suggests that she get her road bike checked in for maintenance.

episodes.title: The Expanding World
episodes.synopsis: To prepare Ami for the Azumi Autumn Ride, the girls take her on a 100km course to gain experience.

episodes.title: Azumi Autumn Ride! Part One
episodes.synopsis: The moment the event begins, Ami ends up seperated from the rest of her team after the staff enforces a gap between them.

episodes.title: Azumi Autumn Ride! Part Two
episodes.synopsis: The girls begin their rush back down the course, using a slipstream technique to allow everyone to move at higher speeds.

episodes.title: The Moment the Town Starts to Move
episodes.synopsis: Yayoi proposes that everyone go on a stargazing night ride to help Ami prepare for taking on a fléche, hiding the fact that she'd be riding all night for 100km.

episodes.title: Long Riders!
episodes.synopsis: Ami and the other girls go on a two-day cycling trip to Shimamami Kaidō.

info.title: Who's Left Behind?
info.synopsis: 1940: Kayoko è una bambina che ha appena iniziato la prima elementare. Tutti nel vicinato sanno che è una piagnucolona. Ama giocare con gli amici e cantare nel cortile della scuola, e di tanto in tanto si diverte con i suoi tre fratelli maggiori. Sua madre è incinta, perciò lei non vede l'ora di diventare una sorella maggiore, intuendo solo in parte le responsabilità che le comporteranno. Nel frattempo, lo sforzo bellico aumenta, e tutti in paese si sentono in dovere di sostenere la nazione, con i propri mezzi.

info.title: Lupin III - All'inseguimento del tesoro di Harimao (ITA)
info.synopsis: Lupin e soci sono intenzionati a mettere le mani sul tesoro di Harimao e per farlo devono prima recuperare le tre statuette indispensabili per trovarlo. Dopo aver rubato la prima scoprono che alle altre sono interessati anche un miliardario e sua figlia. La minaccia principale per il gruppo, però, sarà un gruppo neonazista, intenzionato a sfruttare il lavoro di Lupin III e del miliardario.

episodes.title: Blue-Eyed Casval
episodes.synopsis: U.C. 0068 - While giving his speech to declare the Autonomous Republic of Munzo's independence from the Earth Federation, Zeon Zum Deikun suddenly dies of a heart attack. This causes mass riots in the colony against the Federation while Degwin Zabi, Deikun's deputy, rises to power. In the midst of the chaos, Deikun's children Casval and Artesia, along with Artesia's pet cat Lucifer and Deikun's old friend Jimba Ral, stow away aboard a cargo ship headed for Earth to escape from the Zabi regime.

episodes.title: Artesia`s Sorrow
episodes.synopsis: Three years have passed since Casval, Artesia and Jimba fled to Earth and sought refuge in the castle of Don Teabolo Mass, an aristocrat and trusted friend of the Deikuns, in Andalusia, Spain; Teabolo adopts the children and renames them Édouard and Sayla, respectively. After Jimba is killed in an assassination attack by mercenaries hired by Kycilia Zabi, the Yashima Group, whose president is a good friend of Teabolo, offers to relocate an injured Teabolo and the children to Texas Colony at Side 5: Loum. Upon their arrival, the children meet Char Aznable, who bears a striking resemblance to Édouard. Tragedy strikes the children when they receive word that their mother Astraia has died. After Lucifer dies, Édouard bids farewell to Sayla before heading to the Loum military academy. Meanwhile, Dozle Zabi invites Ramba Ral to participate in a top secret development project that will change the face of Zeon's military forever.

episodes.title: Dawn of Rebellion
episodes.synopsis: Universal Century 0074. Since leaving Texas Colony, Édouard Mass has camouflaged his identity and enrolled in the Autonomous Republic of Zeon's Space Defense Military Academy under the name of Char Aznable. He develops a friendship with his classmate Garma, a scion of the Zabi family. Gradually the two become admired by the other students. Then, in Universal Century 0077, the young at last rise up in arms and begin the fight for independence against the Earth Federation's security forces. This rebellion, however, also marks the beginning of Char’s spectacular scenario of revenge… Now, the gears of history are turning!

episodes.title: Eve of Destiny
episodes.synopsis: Following the success of the Dawn Rebellion, Degwin negotiates with Vice Admiral Revil to surrender all Federation assets and the complete withdrawal of Federation forces from Side 3 to prevent similar incidents from happening again. After bring reprimanded by Degwin for failure to look after Garma, Dozle sends Char - who motivated Garma into starting the rebellion - to Earth; in response, Char requests to become a mobile suit pilot when he returns. Feeling the burden of his responsibilities, Dozle proposes to cadet Zenna Mia. In the Earth city of Manaus, Char lands a job as a mobile worker pilot at a construction site. He meets a young Lalah Sune at a casino

episodes.title: Clash at Loum
episodes.synopsis: On January 3, U.C. 0079, the Principality of Zeon declares war on the Earth Federation and massacres the anti-Zeon government of Side 2 "Hatte". At the same time, a mobile suit assault force led by Kycila captures the moon cities of Granada and Von Braun. At Side 7, Amuro and Hayato Kobayashi are dragged by Kai Shiden and his gang into trespassing in the colony's development sector, only to be arrested and beaten up by Federation guards before they discover Amuro's identity as the son of Tem Ray. Meanwhile, Dozle reveals to Ramba that Gihren has plans to use the captured Island Iffish colony to end the war.

episodes.title: Rise of the Red Comet

Char launches a surprise attack on the Revil fleet on his own before the Dozle fleet arrives and massacres the Federation forces.

episodes.title: Il ritorno di Nehellenia
episodes.synopsis: Hotaru Tomoe has visions of Eternal Sailor Moon. Setsuna arrives at the Tomoe house to pick her up. The girls and Mamoru gather in the park to discover that Chibi-Usa is returning to the future. Meanwhile, Queen Nehelenia is freed from her mirrored prison by an unseen voice. As Chibi-Usa uses her time key to return to Crystal Tokyo with Diana, Nehelenia remembers the events that happened before she had been sealed in the mirror again and she produces her own soul-mirror. Angered, she breaks the mirror and shards fly everywhere. The Soldiers view the shards as shooting stars, but Mamoru recieves one of them in his eye as Chibi-Usa is about to step into the time portal. Unfortunately, the portal disappears leaving the girls puzzled. Later that night, many people gather at an aquarium, including Haruka and Michiru. Some of the nightmare shards land on the roof and form into Nehelenia's Mirror Paredories. Haruka and Michiru are surrounded when Dead Scream is used and Sailor Pluto appears.

episodes.title: L`arrivo di Sailor Saturn
episodes.synopsis: Michiru and Haruka are suprised to see that Hotaru has grown into her normal age, and Sailor Saturn appears. Neherina talks with Mamoru.

episodes.title: Attenti agli specchi!
episodes.synopsis: When a mysterious affliction causes people in Tokyo to do nothing but stare into mirrors, the Sailor Soldiers race against time to try and save Mamoru from this mysterious new enemy.

episodes.title: Le amiche sailor sono in pericolo
episodes.synopsis: Chibiusa is not doing so well after Mamoru is captured, she begins to disappear because without Mamoru she cannot exist.

episodes.title: Battaglia senza fine
episodes.synopsis: Moon struggles to save Mamoru.

episodes.title: La fine dell`incubo
episodes.synopsis: Sailor Moon and friends finally defeat Neherina for good, and rescue Mamoru from her. Now everyone is okay, but Chibiusa and Diana decide to leave for the future for good.

episodes.title: Nuovi incontri
episodes.synopsis: With Neherina down, everything seems to be okay, that is until Galaxia and her animates show their ugly heads. Now, Sailor Moon and gang have another problem, the Sailor Starlights, friend or foe? Also, Usagi watches the departure of Mamoru who heads off to college in America.

episodes.title: A scuola con tre stars
episodes.synopsis: Everyone at Usagi's school is excited that the Three Lights are transferring to Juuban High.  Seiya gets Usagi to show him all the clubs in school.  The football team's captain is turned into a phage named ""Sailor Guts"" by Iron Mouse.  The other Inner Senshi are shocked to learn about the new soldiers.

episodes.title: Le ambizioni di Marta
episodes.synopsis: Minako becomes the Starlights assistant. Usagi also follows her. Sailor Tin Cat takes Saki's star seed. ESM and Venus soon restore it.

episodes.title: Il musical
episodes.synopsis: The Three Lights are rehearsing for their upcoming musical, which they will be starring in. But they seem to have a hard time winning the approval of the stage director, especially Seiya, who feels that he is being personally tested.

episodes.title: La cometa di Wataru
episodes.synopsis: Ami invited Taiki to come and watch the Wataru's Comet pass by Earth with their science teacher, Amanogawa, only to be rejected.

episodes.title: Luna cambia padrone
episodes.synopsis: Yaten temporarily adopts Luna.

episodes.title: Una cuoca provetta
episodes.synopsis: Taiki asks Makoto to appear on a cooking show with him. Usagi decides to tag along, but her clumsiness creates a huge mess at the TV studio.

episodes.title: Il concerto
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and the girls try to buy tockets to a Three Lights concert, only to learn it is already sold out. Michiru then passes by and gives them the tickets, revealing that she will be performing with the Three Lights.

episodes.title: Una giornata insieme
episodes.synopsis: Seiya asks Usagi on a date, to which she reluctantly agrees. Sailor Iron Mouse attempts to make up for her recent failures by going after Seiya's star seed.

episodes.title: Arriva Chibi Chibi
episodes.synopsis: Chibi Chibi arrives in this episode. Pluto tells the sailor scouts to just be on guard around her. Chibi Chibi, like Chibiusa, makes Usagi's family believe that she is Usagi's younger sister. Sailor Aluminum siren first appears in this episode. She takes a police guard's star seed, but it wasn't a real star seed. ESM and pluto arrive. ESM uses her starlight honeymoon therapy kiss to return him back to normal. At home, Usagi is dissappointed that she hasn't heard from Mamoru. Then chibi chibi comes in, Usagi asks if she wet her pants while sleeping. Chibi Chibi frowns, Usagi says she can sleep with her. They both fall asleep.

episodes.title: Vacanze al lago
episodes.synopsis: Siren turns a potter (Rei's cousin) into a phage after he destroys all his work.  Usagi and the girls go camping and run into the Three Lights (they're filming in the area).  They hear news of the ""Camp Ravager"" in the area.  Seiya decides to scare the girls with the monster costume from their movie, but Usagi and Rei run into the phage instead.  After transforming, Mars realizes it's her cousin and Usagi heals him.

episodes.title: Una serata con Seiya
episodes.synopsis: With a rash of break-ins plaguing the neighborhood and the rest of the Tsukino family out of town, Seiya offers to stay over at Usagi's house in case anything happens. But when Seiya's bandmates from The Three Lights, the rest of the Sailor Soldiers, and even the evil Sailors Aluminum Seiren and Lead Crow all show up. Sailor Moon and the rest of the Sailor Soldiers have to fight a monster in the very crowded Tsukino household.

episodes.title: La piccola Mina
episodes.synopsis: Taiki begins to question if their activity as the Three Lights is really helping with their goal of finding their missing princess. His frustration continues to grow, to the point where he no longer feels like singing.

episodes.title: Dolci a volontà
episodes.synopsis: Lately, Chibi-Chibi has been coming home with a lot of snacks. Curious to know where she's been getting all the snacks from, Usagi and the girls decide to follow Chibi-Chibi around for the day.

episodes.title: La grande partita
episodes.synopsis: Usagi finds herself teamed up with Seiya for the annual school softball tournament. To make matters worse, Isagi becomes a target of Seiya's fans, who think she is hitting on him.

episodes.title: Pericolo ad alta quota
episodes.synopsis: Sailor Aluminum Siren learns that Usagi is Sailor Moon. Using this knowledge, she sets a trap on a plane where the Three Lights are holding an in-flight event in order to get Usagi's attention.

episodes.title: Rea la veggente
episodes.synopsis: The Inner Senshi and the Starlights learn each others real identities, but distrust each other, Usagi and Seiya try to bring both groups together.

episodes.title: E` la fine di un`amicizia?
episodes.synopsis: Seiya and Usagi try to stay together after the Outer Senshi and the other two Starlights forbid them from seeing each other.

episodes.title: Quando volano le farfalle
episodes.synopsis: Ami and the others try to clear up the misunderstanding the Three Lights have about Usagi but are unable to get in touch with them. As a last resort, the girls decide to enter a video game tournament where the winner gets a chance to speak with Taiki.

episodes.title: Il grande sogno di Marta
episodes.synopsis: Minako finally gets her chance to audition to be an idol. She realizes that she has to chase her dreams, even in the middle of an attack by the animates.

episodes.title: La festa della scuola
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and her classmates are all busy preparing for the upcoming Juban School Festival. Meanwhile, Sailor Lead Crow finds a note left behind by her deceased friend Sailor Aluminum Siren that contains information on Sailor Moon's true identity.

episodes.title: La principessa
episodes.synopsis: Princess Kakyu, the missing princess whom the Star Lights have long been searching for, finally appears before the Sailor Guardians. Princess Kakyu explains that she has come to Earth in search of the Light of Hope.

episodes.title: I three lights si sciolgono
episodes.synopsis: Usagi finally confesses to Rei that she has been unable to get in touch with Mamoru for the past several months. Meanwhile, the Three Lights publicly announce their intention to disband their group.

episodes.title: I semi di stella
episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Scouts prepare for the final battle against Galaxia. They all transform and prepare to go to thw tower but there is a force filed around it. They think all they can do is watch Galaxia TV as Starlights are attacked by Galaxia. Then, a pink ball of light appears, its Chibu Chibi! She transports them into the tower. They are in front of Galaxia.The Sailor Senshi stand in front of Sailor moon but Galaxia blows them away and then shoots energy balls at them. One goes through each of the them in this order Mercury Venus Jupiter then Mars. Sailor Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, and Saturn cannot believe they are gone. Their star seeds appear and float towards Galaxia. Sailor Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, and Mars say their goodbye. Galaxia shows them all the star seeds she has, Sailor moon notices a golden one in back. It is Mamoru's(Tuxedo Mask's) star seed!

episodes.title: Quando la luna non splende
episodes.synopsis: Sailor Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus lose their star seeds after shielding Sailor Moon and the Star Lights from Galaxia's attack. The four Outer Guardians entrust Sailor Moon to the Star Lights while they try to stop Galaxia.

episodes.title: La guerriera leggendaria
episodes.synopsis: Uranus and Neptune have turned against the Sailor Guardians by swearing allegiance to Galaxia. Despite Sailor Moon's desperate plea, the two continue their attack, forcing Sailor Moon and the Star Lights to retreat.

episodes.title: Il raggio della speranza
episodes.synopsis: Sailor Moon prepares for the final battle with Galaxia.

episodes.title: Sailor Moon e il trionfo delle stelle
episodes.synopsis: As Galaxia closes in to take Sailor Moon's star seed, the Light of Hope finally reveals itself. Turning into a sword, the Light of Hope begs Usagi to use its power to stop Galaxia, who is now fully consumed by Chaos.

info.title: Watari-kun's ****** Is about to Collapse
info.synopsis: Da quando i genitori sono morti, la vita di Naoto Watari ruota completamente attorno alla sorellina: per passare con lei quanto più tempo possibile rifiuta di prendere parte a qualsiasi attività pomeridiana, al punto che molti dei suoi coetanei lo hanno etichettato come "siscon". A Naoto questo non sembra però importare: l'unica cosa importante per lui è la felicità della sorella. All'insaputa di Naoto, tuttavia, un pericolo più grande sembra riemergere - lo stesso pericolo che aveva già distrutto la vita sua e della sorella sei anni prima, e che ora minaccia di farlo di nuovo.

episodes.title: The Day Peace Began to Collapse
episodes.synopsis: Watari Naoto and his sister Suzu try to live a normal life. His destructive childhood friend Satsuki returns.

episodes.title: Small Lies
episodes.synopsis: The plants in the garden are beginning to sprout. But so are the small lies that everybody employs.

episodes.title: Worldly Desires, Begone
episodes.synopsis: Ishihara-san has the image that Naoto is a perfect, kind, chaste saint. Can he kill all his desires, though?

episodes.title: Showing and Being Seen
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is going to the beach. Satsuki and Ishihara get bathing suits. What will Naoto say to them?

episodes.title: Ideal Partner
episodes.synopsis: On their walk, Naoto and Ishihara run into Fujioka, her "ex-boyfriend". What really happened between them?

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.synopsis: After overcoming multiple obstacles, Ishihara finally confesses her feelings to Naoto. What is his response?

episodes.title: After School, Just Before Summer Break
episodes.synopsis: Ishihara and Naoto go on a date at the zoo, albeit with Suzu in tow.

episodes.title: A Cute Junior
episodes.synopsis: Naoto has his first day on the job. Satsuki goes to her new job, but it's in the seedy part of town?!

episodes.title: The Fireworks
episodes.synopsis: After the fireworks, a violent storm forces Naoto, Ishihara-san, and Satsuki to spend the night together.

episodes.title: A Relationship I Don`t Want to Mess Up
episodes.synopsis: Ishihara leaves in the morning, leaving much to be discussed. But Naoto is in the movies and misses 23 calls.

episodes.title: Still a Child
episodes.synopsis: Naoto meets Ishihara's mom who thinks Ishihara is still a child. Then Naoto knocks over a bag with condoms...

episodes.title: Being Independent
episodes.synopsis: Yukari's mom wants Naoto and Yukari to break up. But Naoto decides that he doesn't want to give anything up.

episodes.title: Do You Really Love Her?
episodes.synopsis: Naoto decides to talk to Ishihara-san's mother and his honesty disarms her. Meanwhile, Satsuki is moving away?

episodes.title: Nao-kun Mk. II
episodes.synopsis: Naoto meets Satsuki's family. Why did she have to come home so suddenly? Who's Nao-kun Mk 2?!

episodes.title: What It Means to Love Someone
episodes.synopsis: Satsuki's emotions are a mess. Trying to get rid of the bad feelings, she tells Naoto—

episodes.title: A Contract for Sex
episodes.synopsis: Ishihara-san broke up with Naoto?! And now Satsuki is offering to have sex with Naoto?!

episodes.title: Answers for Satsuki and Ishihara-san
episodes.synopsis: After a long time of soul searching, Naoto finally has an answer for both girls. Who is he going to pick?

episodes.title: What They`re Searching For
episodes.synopsis: Naoto goes back to his old home to get the laptop, but can't find it. Instead he meets a woman named Rika.

episodes.title: Seeing Things
episodes.synopsis: Satsuki has fully disappeared. But on the school trip to Okinawa, Naoto keeps seeing glimpses of her. How?!

episodes.title: Now`s My Chance
episodes.synopsis: Satsuki is leaving Okinawa this afternoon but she still won't meet Naoto. He has to figure out a way see her.

episodes.title: Honest Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Naoto has a date with Satsuki, but Makina wants to spend the day with him. Can he make it on time to Satsuki?

episodes.title: The One I Need
episodes.synopsis: Naoto's unsure about his future, but he's sure who he wants to be with. But will she reciprocate his feelings?

episodes.title: A Story from Another Time
episodes.synopsis: Naoto finally manages to tell Satsuki how he really feels, and Satsuki's also ready to take the plunge.

episodes.title: New Life
episodes.synopsis: Abe tells Tokui that Satsuki might be pregnant! Tokui also finally reveals something about his past love.

episodes.title: The Shape of a Family
episodes.synopsis: Naoto and Satsuki attend Yayoi and Naozumi's wedding. Later they talk about the shape of family.

episodes.title: One Last Thing to Make Sure Of
episodes.synopsis: Naoto and Satsuki's summer together is about to end. Where will their individual paths take them?

info.title: Gaiking il robot guerriero (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Una grave minaccia grava sul pianeta Terra. Il lontano pianeta Zela è ormai sull'orlo della distruzione e tutti i tentativi per salvarlo sono stati vani. Tra questi vi è stata la creazione di un robot senziente, Black Darius, che tuttavia si è ribellato ai suoi creatori per dare inizio ad un piano di conquista dell'universo, insieme ai suoi quattro generali e ad un esercito di zelani trasformati in cyborg dopo averne fatto un lavaggio del cervello. Non potendo tuttavia salvare il pianeta, Black Darius decide di trovare una nuova casa sulla Terra, pianeta molto simile a Zela e che gli zelani avevano studiato per millenni.
La Terra tuttavia non resta a guardare indifesa: il professor Daimoni, infatti, ha creato l'astronave Drago Spaziale e il robot da combattimento Gaiking al fine di contrastare l'invasione degli zeliani.

info.title: Next War Chronicle Ehrgeiz
info.synopsis: La Terra dà inizio alla colonizzazione spaziale creando le Colonie Next, ma queste si ribellano e fondano il Governo Next. La ribellione sfocia in una guerra, e i veicoli multifunzione, i MVs, vengono trasformati in armi da battaglia. Intanto, sulla Terra, la fazione ribelle nota come Terra continua a creare disordini, guidata dal leader psichico Hal. Proprio lui percepisce l’esistenza di una misteriosa creatura simile a un MV, chiamata S.A.C., o semplicemente “S”, che possiede un potere sconosciuto. Next vuole catturare “S” per vincere la guerra, mentre Hal desidera comprenderne la natura. Nessuno lo immagina, ma il destino della Terra, di Next e di Terra stessa finirà nelle mani di un gruppo di fuorilegge che vive nella colonia abbandonata Next 7.

info.title: Wandance
info.synopsis: Kaboku Kotani sta per iniziare il liceo e ha intenzione di continuare con la sua solita vita: andare d'accordo con i suoi amici, starsene in silenzio e non attirare troppo l'attenzione su di sé. In fin dei conti è già abbastanza difficile cavarsela con una balbuzie come la sua, perché dovrebbe peggiorare le cose distinguendosi dalla massa? Ma poi vede un'altra matricola, Hikari Wanda, che balla come se nessuno la stesse guardando... o per essere precisi, a lei non sembra importare del giudizio delle persone. Kaboku, colpito dall'atteggiamento della ragazza, inizia a chiedersi come potrebbe raggiungere la stessa libertà. Per trovare risposta a questo suo dubbio fa una cosa impensabile per lui: iscriversi al club di ballo. Dopotutto ogni cambiamento inizia con un piccolo passo, giusto? Unisciti a Kaboku e Wanda mentre si fanno strada verso la vita e l'amore!

episodes.title: Wanda`s Dance
episodes.synopsis: Kabo, a high school freshman struggling with a stutter, meets Wanda, who dances alone without concern for others. Feeling stifled by what other people think of him, Kabo is captivated by Wanda's free-spirited moves. He begins to take an interest in dance as a form of self-expression.

episodes.title: Dance Club Gender Ratio
episodes.synopsis: During a trial session with the dance club, Kabo learns the basic moves and the importance of truly listening to the music from the club president, On. Though awkward at first, Kabo gradually settles into the club and begins practicing one-on-one with Wanda after school.

episodes.title: Audition
episodes.synopsis: To prepare for a high school dance contest in June, the dance club holds a freestyle audition. Drawn in by Wanda's dancing, Kabo begins to grasp how to let his body be moved by the music. On the way home, he learns about On's hopes for this year's contest.

episodes.title: Choreography Routine
episodes.synopsis: Kabo, Wanda, and Aoi are chosen to take part in the contest. Meanwhile, Yura, who was not selected, struggles to accept the decision. Kabo happens to run into another male club member Iori, who performed in last year's contest.

episodes.title: Feeling
episodes.synopsis: During a battle, Kabo is overwhelmed when he sees Ioris dancing house for the first time. He begins to see the connection between the times he speaks without stuttering and the times he dances and begins to consider a career as a dancer.

episodes.title: Contest
episodes.synopsis: At last, the day of the dance contest arrives for Ichirin High School. With all the unique rival schools gathered, the tension at the venue peaks. Encouraged by Iori and Wanda, Kabo steps onto the stage. Everything hangs on whether the dancers can bring passion to their performance.

episodes.title: Wanda`s Pre-High School Days
episodes.synopsis: The results of the high school dance contest are out. Though they are dancing together, Kabo feels distance from Wanda, and recalls how she used to dance alone when they first met. Before entering high school, Wanda worked part-time at a convenience store while practicing dance entirely on her own.

episodes.title: Dance Battle
episodes.synopsis: Right after the contest, On and Iori face off in a dance battle. Kabo and Wanda are both in awe of how the pair challenges each other's technique and style as they reach new heights. After the club members judge, Iori selects Kabo as On's next battle opponent.

episodes.title: The Style Wall
episodes.synopsis: Kabo starts training with Iori during lunch and begins to discover the thrill of dance battles. Iori mentions a skilled dancer called Gaku Kabeya, or Kabe, who specializes in breakdancing. Iori invites Kabo and Wanda to join the B-BOY's practice at the park, where Kabe is also training.

episodes.title: Prelims
episodes.synopsis: The solo division of the Inter-High Dance Battle begins, and On, Iori, and Wanda advance smoothly through the prelims. Shaken by Wanda's absence and the unfamiliar environment, Kabo messes up his timing. Confused, he finishes the prelims without showing his true strengths.

episodes.title: Self-Awareness
episodes.synopsis: In the second match of round one in the Inter-High Dance Battle, On faces Usen Takumi, a dancer with a unique style. Kabo is moved by the fierce performances of On and Wanda, unlike anything he has seen in practice. But Kabe thinks battles are meaningless unless you win.

episodes.title: Wandance
episodes.synopsis: Kabo faces Kabe in the semifinals. Taking the first turn, Kabe blindfolds himself with a mask, and finishes the first song as if to say Kabo's dance is not even worth watching. Confronting Kabe's raw emotion head-on, Kabo's own feelings begin to break free.

info.title: So You're Raising a Warrior
info.synopsis: Ell vuole morire, ma nessun eroe è abbastanza forte da ucciderlo… dunque vuole allevare qualcuno in grado di farlo!

episodes.title: The Last Warrior
episodes.synopsis: Ell the dragon, Lafi the magician, and Dino the baby warrior become an unconventional family.

episodes.title: A Special Training for a Warrior
episodes.synopsis: Lafi goes for a job interview, leaving Ell to care for Dino. Ell begins Dino's warrior training.

episodes.title: First Day of Work
episodes.synopsis: Lafi works as a healer, restoring the hair of bald mages. Ell meets a Demon Hunter, who helps look after Dino.

episodes.title: Grandma Helga
episodes.synopsis: Someone keeps hunting animals and leaving them in front of Ell and Lafi's house every day.

episodes.title: Here Is the Second of Four Guardians
episodes.synopsis: The Second of Four Guardians pays Ell and Lafi a visit, and has a request.

episodes.title: The Warrior`s Candidate
episodes.synopsis: Verr searches for a Warrior strong enough to defeat the Demon Lord.

episodes.synopsis: Ell's Dad thinks that Ell has started a family, and pays him and Lafi a visit.

episodes.title: Warrior`s Destiny
episodes.synopsis: Ell, Lafi and Verr prepare for Dino's first birthday party.

episodes.title: A Perfect First Birthday Party
episodes.synopsis: On the day of Dino's first birthday party, the weather is terrible. Will anyone show up?

episodes.title: Stay-at-Home Dad Depression
episodes.synopsis: Ell has been acting depressed lately, so Lafi and Verr make plans to cheer him up.

episodes.title: Avenge
episodes.synopsis: The priests from the Radiant Temple find Ell and Verr, and a battle ensues.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.synopsis: Lafi has a change of heart and returns to assist Ell and Verr in their fight against the priests.

info.title: A Misanthrope Teaches a Class for Demi-Humans
info.synopsis: Rei Hitoma è un ex insegnante che, per motivi legati a traumi passati, ha sviluppato una profonda misantropia e un'avversione verso gli esseri umani. Dopo due anni di inattività, decide di accettare un nuovo incarico in una scuola remota, immersa nella natura, sperando di trovare un'esistenza tranquilla e lontana dagli altri. Ma il suo primo giorno di lavoro lo coglie di sorpresa: incontra uno studente con orecchie da animale! Scopre così che la scuola in cui è approdato non ospita studenti comuni, ma "demi umani", esseri non del tutto umani che desiderano diventarlo. Da questa premessa nasce una strana situazione: un uomo che disprezza l’umanità si trova ad insegnare agli altri… che significato abbia la “umanità”.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Fateful Classroom
episodes.synopsis: Rei Hitoma accepts a teaching job, only to learn that his students are demi-humans aiming to become human.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Fleeting Crown of Bubbles
episodes.synopsis: Rei learns why Kyoka wants to become a dancer. A mysterious yet familiar girl appears in the classroom.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Lonely Castle Under the Full Moon
episodes.synopsis: Isaki stops attending class and refuses to leave her room, until Rei encounters her by chance one night.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Angel`s Comet
episodes.synopsis: Sui learns some unexpected news about Seiko Kizaki, the human she's indebted to, and turns to Rei for help.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and Tobari`s Hymn
episodes.synopsis: Rei ruins his colleague's handkerchief by accident, only to discover that Tobari witnessed the whole thing.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Light of Dawn
episodes.synopsis: The advanced class gets their final assignments needed to graduate, but one student finds herself struggling.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Fruitless Love Fortune
episodes.synopsis: It's a new school year, and the advanced class has three new students, including a dragon in love with Rei.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Magic for Peace and Quiet
episodes.synopsis: Rei meets Neneko's guardian, a powerful witch, and learns the true reason Neneko seeks to be human.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Heart`s Deepest Desire
episodes.synopsis: Graduation assignment season is here again, and the advanced class tackles the unique tasks set upon them.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Comet`s Pilgrimage
episodes.synopsis: The advanced class decides to throw a surprise graduation ceremony. Sui asks Rei to deliver a letter.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Nigh Past
episodes.synopsis: The new assistant homeroom teacher for the advanced class turns out to be a familiar face from Rei's past.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and Falsehood Found Nigh
episodes.synopsis: The advanced class goes on a field trip to the nearby convenience store to learn about human society.

episodes.title: The Misanthrope and the Nigh Future
episodes.synopsis: Final assignments are here yet again, but it's not only the advanced class that are having trouble with them.

info.title: Acrobunch
info.synopsis: La famiglia Randou, guidata dallo scienziato Tatsuya Rendou, decide di compiere un viaggio che potrebbe portare alla scoperta di un favoloso tesoro, per questo motivo va in cerca di antiche rovine per scoprire la leggenda di Quetzalcoatl, ma un organizzazione malvagia di nome Gopurin è sulle loro tracce per impossessarsi del tesoro prima della famiglia Randou, che dalla sua parte ha un'arma segreta, Acrobunch.

info.title: Akane-banashi
info.synopsis: Il rakugo è un genere teatrale giapponese nel quale un narratore racconta mediante un monologo, ma anche tramite le proprie movenze ed espressioni, delle storie capaci di ipnotizzare gli spettatori. Shinta e sua figlia Akane sono stati conquistati da questa forma di arte così espressiva. La ragazza dopo aver trascorso anni osservando il padre decide che è giunto il suo momento, ma imporsi in questo mondo scintillante non sarà facile.

episodes.title: That Day
episodes.synopsis:
Akane Osaki, a fifth-grade student, captivated by the magical Rakugo performance of her father, Shinta Arakawa.
Determined to support the family who have always stood behind his dream, Shinta takes on the promotion exam to achieve the highest rank in the Rakugo world—Shin’uchi. 
As Akane and the others look on, Shinta delivers a performance that showcases his true skill. However, the exam takes a shocking and completely unexpected turn that no one could have foreseen.

episodes.title: First Performance
episodes.synopsis:
Guriko Arakawa, a fledgling Futatsume (the second-highest rank Rakugo performer), begins investigating a rumor that his master, Shiguma Arakawa, has been secretly meeting a young woman.
What he discovers, however, is Akane, now a high school student, receiving private Rakugo lessons from Shiguma at a karaoke box.
Around that time, Shiguma receives word that a performer is urgently needed to fill a slot at an event at “Rakugo Cafe.”
Yet instead of choosing the more experienced Guriko, Shiguma unexpectedly nominates Akane.

episodes.title: Senior Apprentices
episodes.synopsis:
After performing for the first time and being motivated by Kaisei Arakawa's Rakugo performance, Akane is officially accepted as Shiguma's apprentice. He introduces her to her unique senior apprentices and the disciplined Kyoji Arakawa takes her under his wing.
Akane is sure that she’ll get to hone her artistic Rakugo skills, but all Kyoji orders her to do is menial tasks.
On top of that, he sends her to train at the most unexpected place…

episodes.title: Beyond Joy
episodes.synopsis:
During her training at the Izakaya “Umi”, Akane learns the art of “attentiveness”. Kyoji takes her to his next job at a retirement home, where Rakugo is the recreational event of the day.
Determined to make sure her elderly audience members enjoy themselves, Akane shows off the results of her training on stage. Following her, Kyoji takes the stage, determined to show her the dignity and authority as her senior apprentice.

episodes.title: Her Path Forward
episodes.synopsis:
Now that midterms are over, senior high schooler Akane, can finally breathe a sigh of relief—but only for a fleeting moment. She is soon called in for a career counseling session with her homeroom teacher, Ms. Iwashimizu, a.k.a. the “Ice Lady.”
Though Akane's set on becoming a Rakugoka, Iwashimizu is insistent that she instead go to college, a more realistic goal. Desperate to win her over, Akane turns to her friends for advice on how to change her mind...

episodes.title: Terakoya
episodes.synopsis: The Karaku Cup is a Rakugo contest for students. When Akane learns that Issho Arakawa will be presiding as its chief judge, she asks Shiguma for permission to enter. He gives her one condition: To win with "Jugemu". It's a tall order for her to try to win with such a well-known story, so along with Guriko, Akane turns to Koguma Arakawa, the "Terakoya," a grassroots teacher of the Shiguma School, for advice. Koguma's a walking encyclopedia of Rakugo, but...

episodes.title: Karaku Cup
episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the Karaku Cup preliminary round. This year, all eyes are on the defending two-time champion, Karashi Nerimaya, and a rising young voice actress, Hikaru Koragi. But Kaisei, the emcee of the event, has told a reporter that his money is on Akane, an unknown high school student, to win it all. At the venue, Koguma, Guriko, and Ms. Iwashimizu are ready to watch over Akane from their seats. Facing such stiff competition, can Akane advance past the prelims with "Jugemu"?

episodes.title: What They Want
episodes.synopsis:
The Karaku Cup finals are now underway. The chief judge, Issho Arakawa, has taken his place at the venue. Following a stream of performances, it's time for one of the frontrunners, Karashi Nerimaya, to take the stage. Karashi's specialty is "Modernized Rakugo", 
— modern interpretations of classic Rakugo stories. This bold approach gets him some big laughs from the audience, but what will Issho's verdict be?

episodes.title: Expressionist
episodes.synopsis:
The Karaku Cup final continues. Following Karashi, voice actress Hikaru Koragi takes the stage.
Determined to be judged not for her looks, but for her acting skills, she competes in the Karaku Cup.
To showcase her expressiveness, she performs a sentimental story.
Coincidentally, it's "Shibahama" - the story
that Shinta performed during his Shin'uchi Promotion Test six years ago. Hikaru's passionate performance rocks the audience, and in its wake, Akane takes the stage at last.

episodes.title: Jugemu
episodes.synopsis: In contrast to her performance in the prelims, where she put her enunciation skills on full display, Akane delivers "Jugemu" in a relatively relaxed manner during the finals. Karashi and Hikaru suspect that she's throwing the match, but in fact, she's taken a true Rakugoka's approach - bringing the audience down from the high of the previous sets into a comfortable lull. As she leans into her characters' emotions, effortlessly enthralling her listeners with her gentle tone, Akane gradually reaches a new level in her performance.

episodes.title: Answer
episodes.synopsis:
Face to face with Issho Arakawa, Akane asks him point-blank why he had expelled Shinta.
After he sends the journalists out of the room, Issho informs her that he can see right through the fact that Akane is training under Shiguma. As Akane flinches, he reveals the truth behind the expulsion six years ago- the truth he has never shared before. Now that she's finally learned the reason behind her father's expulsion, what could be going through Akane's mind?

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.synopsis:
After winning the Karaku Cup, Akane suddenly finds herself in the spotlight at school. 
But unconvinced that her performance was good enough to blow Issho away, she has mixed feelings about it all. And now, graduation day is approaching. Motivated by Akane’s success, her friends have started to pursue their own dreams. Meanwhile, Shiguma racks his brain, trying to come up with a stage name for Akane, who’ll officially become his apprentice once she graduates. And as her thoughts turn to her father, Shinta, Akane ponders the meaning of her own given name.

info.title: Draw This, Then Die!
info.synopsis: La liceale Ai Yasumi vive a Izuoujima, una delle tante piccole isole a sud di Tokyo. Un giorno si rende conto che riesce a "creare" i manga che tanto ama leggere. Inizia così a vivere folli avventure!

episodes.title: Magic House: What Would a Manga Protagonist Do Here?
episodes.synopsis: Ai Yasumi’s love for manga inspires her to start creating stories of her own.

episodes.title: You Are Brilliant: Drawing Manga Is Hard
episodes.synopsis: Ai draws manga for the first time in order to convince Teshima-sensei to become the manga club's advisor.

episodes.title: Kokoro`s Heart: Draw This, Then Die!!!!
episodes.synopsis: While on the search for a third manga club member, Ai comes across Kokoro, an introvert with a talent for art.

episodes.title: Utopia: Making Manga`s Better with Others
episodes.synopsis: Ai and Kokoro begin a long process of trial and error as they try and create their first manga as a club.

episodes.title: Let`s All Go Together! Put Your Feelings into Manga

episodes.synopsis: Comitia is finally here, and the members of the Manga Research Club learn how hard it is to sell doujinshi.

episodes.title: The Lost World: Draw with the Intent to Kill
episodes.synopsis: On the ferry back from Tokyo, Rei remembers her time as a manga artist assistant while pursuing serialization.

episodes.title: Touch: 100 Things I Want to Draw for Manga!!!

episodes.title: Surfing the Cyber Seas: Draw for Yourself, Not for Others!
episodes.synopsis: Ai and the others decide to create a social media account to promote their manga before the next Comitia.

episodes.title: 90% of Everything Is Crap: I Need Friends to Become Stronger Than Mama
episodes.synopsis: As the school festival draws near, Sachi comes up with a plan to befriend the ever-unapproachable Hikaru.

episodes.title: The Two of Us ~ Partners Who Complement Each Other Are Precious!

episodes.title: Next World: Draw What You Love. Now and Forever...

info.title: One-Room TA
info.synopsis: Uyun, studente universitario, incontra Jinhyeong, l'affascinante assistente didattico del suo corso. Senza pensarci troppo, gli confessa i propri sentimenti e da quel momento le loro vite iniziano a intrecciarsi in modi imprevedibili. Ben presto i due finiscono per vivere insieme, e la convivenza rivela lati inaspettati di Jinhyeong: dietro la sua timidezza si nasconde una fantasia vivace e originale che trasforma ogni momento condiviso in occasioni di sorpresa, risate e intimità. Giorno dopo giorno, tra piccole eccentricità e momenti teneri, Uyun e Jinhyeong imparano a conoscersi davvero, trovando nel loro rapporto un equilibrio fatto di complicità, curiosità e affetto crescente.

info.title: Horror Collector
info.synopsis: Fushigi viaggia attraverso il Giappone alla ricerca della sorella gemella Himitsu, una ragazza capace di trasformare le leggende metropolitane in realtà. Con lui c'è Jimmy, un ex fotografo che, dopo un misterioso incidente, si ritrova nel corpo di un cane con volto umano. Nel loro percorso si imbattono in città sconvolte da apparizioni e fenomeni strani, dove storie di paura e miti locali prendono forma concreta. Caso dopo caso, Fushigi cerca di capire l'origine di questi eventi e di avvicinarsi sempre di più alla sorella scomparsa, mentre il confine tra mondo reale e soprannaturale si fa ogni giorno più fragile.

episodes.title: The Red Notebook
episodes.synopsis: Rumors spread about a mysterious figure in a hood as people start noticing surreal and terrifying apparitions.

episodes.title: The Shadow Enveloping the City
episodes.synopsis: Several girls hear a voice in the woods and notice a strange woman lurking in the background of their photos.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Fushigi's search for Himitsu leads him to the publishers Jimmy worked at while he was still completely human.
